subject: Onboarding guardrails: SSO, SCIM & service accounts
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fintechco.com>, security@fintechco.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding guardrails: SSO, SCIM & service accounts

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. Per our agreement I wanted to surface a short checklist for the parts of onboarding that touch access controls so we can lock the mutual action plan (MAP). Key items we’ll need to coordinate:

1) SSO / SAML metadata (IdP metadata XML and ACS/Entity IDs)
2) SCIM provisioning mapping (user -> role attributes, external_id behavior)
3) Service accounts & API keys for automated provisioning (who will own these on your side)
4) IP allowlist / egress policy for dedicated connectors (CIDR ranges + maintenance window)
5) Org policies (minimum password / session settings for users managed via SCIM)

I’ve attached a compact playbook and a mapping sheet that describes Redwood’s recommended SCIM schema and default attribute set. Please review the mapping and confirm if you require custom attributes (e.g., department_code, cost_center).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the IdP metadata attachment or a download link (target: EOD Wed)
- We exchange SCIM test account credentials for initial provisioning (target: Thu)
- Redwood creates the service account and provides a short-lived token for initial sync (we will rotate after handoff)

If you prefer, Monica (our implementation lead) can run a short 30-minute pairing session to validate the SAML assertion and SCIM sync.

Thanks,
Soojin
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sso-scim-playbook.pdf, fintechco-mapping-sheet.xlsx

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fintechco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@fintechco.com, procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding guardrails: SSO, SCIM & service accounts

Soojin / Monica —

Thanks for the clear checklist. A few quick questions from our side before the pairing session:

- For SSO, can Redwood act as SP-initiated only, or do you support IdP-initiated flows as well? We prefer IdP-initiated for our users.
- We need the exact SP ACS URL and the certificate thumbprint to validate with our security team.
- On SCIM: we do use a custom attribute "department_code" and will need it mapped to the role field in Redwood. Can you confirm Redwood will permit a custom attribute mapping?
- IP allowlist: we lock down egress to a short list of CIDR ranges and require change notifications 48 hours in advance. Can Redwood publish the minimal CIDR set and a change calendar?

Also, for procurement: procurement@fintechco.com asked that we include a single point of contact for billing and for future SLA escalation.

Alex Rivera
Head of Platform
FinTechCo

>

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fintechco.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding guardrails: SSO, SCIM & service accounts

Alex —

Short answers and plan from our implementation side:

- SSO flows: Redwood supports both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated. We’ll provide both ACS endpoints and the EntityID. For IdP-initiated you only need to add our SP EntityID to the IdP console.
- SP details: ACS (prod): https://api.redwoodinference.com/saml/acs/fintechco ; EntityID: https://redwoodinference.com/saml/sp ; Certificate (SHA-256 thumbprint): 3F:9A:BB:... (full cert attached in playbook)
- SCIM custom attributes: we support flexible mappings. Monica will update the mapping sheet to add department_code -> role.name mapping and mark it for review (attached: fintechco-mapping-sheet.xlsx).
- IP allowlist: Redwood Dedicated uses a small stable set of egress IP ranges. Diego — can you paste the minimal CIDR set here? We will commit to a 72-hour notification window for scheduled changes; emergency changes will be routed via our platform pager and require approval from security@fintechco.com.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

> On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 10:42 AM Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fintechco.com> wrote:
> > Soo...

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fintechco.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, security@fintechco.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding guardrails: SSO, SCIM & service accounts

Alex / team —

Minimal CIDR ranges for the Dedicated connectors (current stable set):
- 34.210.12.0/24
- 52.23.45.0/24
- 3.88.101.0/24

We are committing to a 72-hour planned-change notice for those ranges. Operational notes: any emergency rotation of egress addresses will route via our incident channel and we will send a signed notification to security@fintechco.com; we will also publish the change in the shared Drive folder.

About service accounts: Redwood will provision a service account per customer for provisioning flows. The initial token we hand off will be short-lived (7 days) and we’ll rotate and hand a long-lived key stored in your KMS if requested. Please confirm who on your side will own the KMS/HSM responsibilities for long-term key storage.

Diego Fernandez
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding guardrails: SSO, SCIM & service accounts

Thanks — that looks good. A couple of confirmations from security/procurement:

- We will proceed with IdP-initiated SSO as the primary flow. Our IdP admin (security@fintechco.com) will upload your SP metadata.
- The three CIDR blocks look acceptable; please add a short change log entry in the Drive folder whenever you plan a rotation.
- For key ownership: FinTechCo will hold the long-term KMS key; procurement will sign the schedule after we get the final MAP.

Please go ahead and publish the MAP (final) and I’ll route it to procurement for signature.

Regards,
Alex

Alex / procurement —

Great — I’ve attached the final MAP (m-a-p-onboarding-v1.docx) and updated the Drive folder with the cert and the mapping sheet. Action items for both sides:

- FinTechCo: procurement to review & sign MAP (procurement@fintechco.com)
- FinTechCo: upload our SP metadata into your IdP console (security@fintechco.com)
- Redwood: provision service account and deliver short-lived token (Soojin)
- Redwood: schedule the pairing session (Monica) for Wed 11/17 10:00 PT to validate SAML assertion and run a SCIM cycle

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and the DocuSign link for the MAP. If procurement needs an edited terms summary we can produce a one-page addendum.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the pairing session.

Soojin Lee

Redwood Inference
